description.en: Shows the comeback monologue of a match (makikaeshi = comeback). Before opening the message it sets number placeholder 1 to the goal gap plus one: CMND_BTL_GET_POINT(0) - CMND_BTL_GET_POINT(1) + 1, team 0 being the player's team and 1 the opponent. The text then shows like CreateMonologue.
Screen to draw on, e.g. SCREEN_A.

examples.case: During a match scene (real usage, from ev44120026.nut)
